responsibility: Implements general RTL analysis utilities that inspect instruction patterns, expressions, and addresses. Besides supplying the runtime support for the subrtx iterators, it contains helpers for register/set and side-effect analysis, nonzero/sign-bit reasoning hooks, address decomposition into base/index/displacement/autoinc forms, symbolic-reference detection, auto-inc note creation, and assorted structural predicates used widely by RTL optimizers, reload, and target code.
same_name_distinction: Implements the broad body of RTL analysis code, including subrtx-iterator runtime support, address decomposition, register/set inspection, symbolic-reference tests, and many predicates that are historically declared through rtl.h; unlike gcc/rtlanal.h, it is the main implementation file rather than the newer focused interface for reference-collection abstractions and selected predicates.
